card.name: Small linking words near aluminum or Alabama
card.fires_on: Small linking words (at, with, and, of) that come shortly after the word aluminum or in an Alabama place name. It marks a spot where a word like aluminum, Alabama or Birmingham could come next.

modes.label: Alabama place names
